source: Official backend CONFIG lookup values normalized from Technical.pdf Appendix 2 and BERSn chapter 3.
notes: All calculation fields are backend-owned values backed by the Technical.pdf source listed on each row.
renderShadingType and shadingCoverage are frontend 3D rendering hints only; not compliance calculation inputs.
hint/hintZh: UI tooltip shown to users. tableRef: manual section. validRange: allowed input bounds.
layers: material layers for U-value calculation. U = 1/(Ri + Σ(d/λ) + Ro), Ri=0.11, Ro=0.04 (ISO 6946).

wallConstructions.name: RC外壁構造
wallConstructions.hint: Standard RC exterior wall. U-value looked up from Appendix 2 Table 6. Check EVc compliance threshold before use.
wallConstructions.hintZh: 標準RC外牆，U值由附錄二表6查取。請確認是否符合EVc門檻值。
wallConstructions.source: Technical.pdf Appendix 2 Attachment 1 Table 6 RC 外壁構造 (U=3.49 W/m²K)

wallConstructions.name: 非住宿類外牆 Uaw 基準
wallConstructions.hint: Non-residential Uaw baseline threshold (2.0 W/m²·K). Buildings must not exceed this value for compliance.
wallConstructions.hintZh: 非住宿類外牆熱傳透率基準值（2.0 W/m²·K），建築設計值不得超過此基準。
wallConstructions.source: Technical.pdf Appendix 2 Table 1 非住宿類建築外牆平均熱傳透率 Uaw 基準值

wallConstructions.name: S構造外牆（帷幕牆）
wallConstructions.hint: Steel structure curtain wall. U-value from Appendix 2 Table 8. Common in high-rise commercial buildings.
wallConstructions.hintZh: S構造帷幕牆，U值由附錄二表8查取，常用於高層商業建築。
wallConstructions.source: Technical.pdf Appendix 2 Attachment 1 Table 8 S 構造外牆 (U=1.25 W/m²K)

wallConstructions.name: 非住宿類外牆 Uaw 節能極限
wallConstructions.hint: Non-residential Uaw energy-saving limit (1.0 W/m²·K). This is the best-practice target for high-performance buildings.
wallConstructions.hintZh: 非住宿類外牆節能極限值（1.0 W/m²·K），高效能建築設計目標值。
wallConstructions.source: Technical.pdf Appendix 2 Table 1 非住宿類建築外牆平均熱傳透率 Uaw 節能極限值

wallConstructions.name: 自訂外牆構造（輸入k值+厚度）
wallConstructions.hint: Enter each material layer: thickness d (mm) and thermal conductivity λ (W/m·K). U is calculated automatically using ISO 6946.
wallConstructions.hintZh: 輸入每層材料厚度d(mm)與導熱係數λ(W/m·K)，系統依ISO 6946自動計算U值。Ri=0.11, Ro=0.04。

roofConstructions.name: RC構造屋頂
roofConstructions.hint: Standard RC roof. U-value from Appendix 2 Table 7. Check against Uar EVc threshold for compliance.
roofConstructions.hintZh: 標準RC屋頂，U值由附錄二表7查取。請確認是否符合Uar EVc門檻值。
roofConstructions.source: Technical.pdf Appendix 2 Attachment 1 Table 7 RC 構造屋頂 (U=0.75 W/m²K)

roofConstructions.name: 屋頂平均熱傳透率 Uar 節能極限
roofConstructions.hint: Roof energy-saving limit (0.4 W/m²·K). RC with insulation layer to meet the energy-saving extreme threshold.
roofConstructions.hintZh: 屋頂節能極限值（0.4 W/m²·K），RC加隔熱層達到節能極限門檻。
roofConstructions.source: Technical.pdf Appendix 2 Table 1 基本門檻指標屋頂平均熱傳透率 Uar 節能極限值

roofConstructions.name: 屋頂平均熱傳透率 Uar 基準
roofConstructions.hint: Roof baseline threshold (0.8 W/m²·K). Minimum compliance requirement for non-residential roofs.
roofConstructions.hintZh: 屋頂基準值（0.8 W/m²·K），非住宿類建築屋頂最低合規要求。
roofConstructions.source: Technical.pdf Appendix 2 Table 1 基本門檻指標屋頂平均熱傳透率 Uar 基準值

roofConstructions.name: S構造屋頂
roofConstructions.hint: Steel structure roof. U-value from Appendix 2 Table 9. Often used in factory and warehouse buildings.
roofConstructions.hintZh: S構造屋頂，U值由附錄二表9查取，常用於廠房、倉庫類建築。
roofConstructions.source: Technical.pdf Appendix 2 Attachment 1 Table 9 S 構造屋頂 (U=1.02 W/m²K)

roofConstructions.name: 自訂屋頂構造（輸入k值+厚度）
roofConstructions.hint: Enter each roof layer: thickness d (mm) and thermal conductivity λ (W/m·K). Ri=0.10 (horizontal surface), Ro=0.04.
roofConstructions.hintZh: 輸入每層屋頂材料厚度d(mm)與導熱係數λ(W/m·K)，系統自動計算U值。Ri=0.10（水平表面），Ro=0.04。

shadingTypes.name: 非住宿窗平均遮陽係數 SF 基準：開窗率 > 50%
shadingTypes.tableRef: Technical.pdf Appendix 2, Table 1 — SF baseline by WWR band
shadingTypes.hint: For WWR > 50%. Ki=0.2. High window ratio requires tighter shading control. Verify WWR before selecting.
shadingTypes.hintZh: 適用開窗率>50%，Ki=0.2。高開窗率需嚴格控制遮陽。選擇前請確認實際開窗率。
shadingTypes.source: Technical.pdf Appendix 2 Table 1 非住宿類建築窗平均遮陽係數 SF 基準值

shadingTypes.name: 非住宿窗平均遮陽係數 SF 基準：50% ≥ 開窗率 > 40%
shadingTypes.hint: For WWR between 40% and 50%. Ki=0.3. Horizontal overhang type shading is representative.
shadingTypes.hintZh: 適用開窗率40%–50%，Ki=0.3，代表性遮陽形式為水平遮陽板。
shadingTypes.source: Technical.pdf Appendix 2 Table 1 非住宿類建築窗平均遮陽係數 SF 基準值

shadingTypes.name: 非住宿窗平均遮陽係數 SF 基準：40% ≥ 開窗率 > 30%
shadingTypes.hint: For WWR between 30% and 40%. Ki=0.4. Vertical fin type shading is representative.
shadingTypes.hintZh: 適用開窗率30%–40%，Ki=0.4，代表性遮陽形式為垂直遮陽板（翼牆）。
shadingTypes.source: Technical.pdf Appendix 2 Table 1 非住宿類建築窗平均遮陽係數 SF 基準值

shadingTypes.name: 非住宿窗平均遮陽係數 SF 基準：30% ≥ 開窗率 > 20%
shadingTypes.hint: For WWR between 20% and 30%. Ki=0.5. Eggcrate (combined horizontal + vertical) shading is representative.
shadingTypes.hintZh: 適用開窗率20%–30%，Ki=0.5，代表性遮陽形式為蛋形格柵（水平+垂直複合遮陽）。
shadingTypes.source: Technical.pdf Appendix 2 Table 1 非住宿類建築窗平均遮陽係數 SF 基準值

shadingTypes.name: 非住宿窗平均遮陽係數 SF 節能極限：40% ≥ 開窗率 > 30%
shadingTypes.hint: Energy-saving limit for WWR 30%–40%. Ki=0.2. Louver type with high shading performance required to reach this limit.
shadingTypes.hintZh: 開窗率30%–40%之節能極限，Ki=0.2，需採用高遮陽性能之百葉遮陽才能達到此極限值。
shadingTypes.source: Technical.pdf Appendix 2 Table 1 非住宿類建築窗平均遮陽係數 SF 節能極限值

glazingTypes.name: 6mm 單層清玻璃
glazingTypes.hint: Standard single clear glass. High Ug and ηi — significant solar heat gain. Only suitable for well-shaded or north-facing facades.
glazingTypes.hintZh: 標準單層清玻璃，Ug與ηi均高，太陽熱得量大。僅適用於遮陽完善或北向立面。
glazingTypes.source: Technical.pdf Appendix 2 Table 5 常用玻璃熱傳透率 Ui

glazingTypes.name: 6mm 單層反射/染色玻璃
glazingTypes.hint: Reflective or tinted glass. Same Ug as clear glass but ηi reduced to 0.5 — reduces solar heat gain by ~40%.
glazingTypes.hintZh: 反射或染色玻璃，Ug與清玻璃相同，ηi降低至0.5，太陽熱得量減少約40%。

glazingTypes.name: 6+A6+6 空氣層6mm雙層玻璃
glazingTypes.hint: Double glazing with 6mm air gap. Significantly better thermal insulation than single glass. Good choice for most applications.
glazingTypes.hintZh: 空氣層6mm雙層玻璃，隔熱性能比單層玻璃顯著提升，適用於大多數場合。

glazingTypes.name: 6+A12+6 空氣層12mm雙層玻璃
glazingTypes.tableRef: Technical.pdf Appendix 2, Table 5; Table 4 — Low-E emissivity
glazingTypes.hint: Double glazing with 12mm air gap (standard BERSn default). Better insulation than 6mm gap version. Recommended baseline selection.
glazingTypes.hintZh: 空氣層12mm雙層玻璃（BERSn系統預設值），隔熱性優於6mm版本，建議作為基準選項。

glazingTypes.name: 10+A12+10 空氣層12mm雙層玻璃
glazingTypes.hint: Thicker pane double glazing. Marginally better Ug than 6mm pane version. Used where structural loads allow thicker glass.
glazingTypes.hintZh: 較厚玻璃雙層玻璃，Ug略優於6mm版本，適用於結構允許採用較厚玻璃之場合。

glazingTypes.name: 12+A12+12 空氣層12mm雙層玻璃（厚板）
glazingTypes.hint: Heavy pane double glazing. Best Ug among standard double-glazing options. Highest structural load.
glazingTypes.hintZh: 重型玻璃雙層玻璃，標準雙層玻璃中Ug最低，結構荷重最大。

hvacSystems.name: 個別空調四級能效（非住宅）
hvacSystems.hint: Individual split/VRF AC system, Grade 4 efficiency. EAC=0.79 from formula 16b. Less efficient than Grade 2.
hvacSystems.hintZh: 個別空調系統四級能效，EAC=0.79由公式16b計算，效率低於二級。
hvacSystems.source: Technical.pdf Appendix 2 §4(C), formula 16b individual AC EAC

hvacSystems.name: 個別空調二級能效（非住宅）
hvacSystems.hint: Individual split/VRF AC system, Grade 2 efficiency (BERSn default). EAC=0.64. Standard selection for modern office buildings.
hvacSystems.hintZh: 個別空調系統二級能效（BERSn預設值），EAC=0.64，現代辦公建築標準選項。
hvacSystems.source: Technical.pdf Appendix 2 §4(C), formula 16b individual AC EAC

hvacSystems.name: 50USRT以下中央空調二級主機
hvacSystems.hint: Central chiller plant ≤50 USRT, Grade 2. EAC=0.70. Suitable for medium-scale commercial buildings.
hvacSystems.hintZh: 50USRT以下中央空調二級主機，EAC=0.70，適用於中型商業建築。
hvacSystems.source: Technical.pdf Appendix 2 §4(B), formula 15 small central AC EAC

hvacSystems.name: 50USRT以下中央空調一級變頻主機
hvacSystems.tableRef: Technical.pdf Appendix 2 §4(B), Formula 15 + HT variable-speed rule
hvacSystems.formula: EAC = 1 − (BW × HT × Arx), HT=1.1 for variable speed
hvacSystems.hint: High-efficiency variable-speed chiller, Grade 1. EAC=0.56. Best EAC among lookup options. Significant energy savings.
hvacSystems.hintZh: 高效能變頻一級主機，EAC=0.56，查表選項中最優值，節能效益顯著。
hvacSystems.source: Technical.pdf Appendix 2 §4(B), formula 15 and HT variable-speed rule

lightingSystems.name: 照明功率密度基準（無管理優惠）
lightingSystems.hint: No lighting management system. β=1.0. EL=1.0 (no efficiency credit). Baseline — consider upgrading for better EEI.
lightingSystems.hintZh: 無照明管理系統，β=1.0，EL=1.0，無節能優惠。建議升級以改善EEI。
lightingSystems.source: Technical.pdf Appendix 2 §5 formula 17 and Table 11 office LPD baseline 15 W/m²

lightingSystems.name: 合理迴路節電控制
lightingSystems.tableRef: Technical.pdf Appendix 2, Table 10 — βi management factor
lightingSystems.hint: Basic circuit-level on/off control. β=0.95. Minimal credit — simple switching by circuit zone.
lightingSystems.hintZh: 基本迴路節電控制，β=0.95，依迴路分區開關控制。
lightingSystems.source: Technical.pdf Appendix 2 Table 10 照明能源管理優惠係數 βi

lightingSystems.name: 自動點滅控制
lightingSystems.hint: Automatic occupancy/time-based on/off control. β=0.90. BERSn default — good balance of cost and performance.
lightingSystems.hintZh: 自動點滅控制（感應或時程），β=0.90，BERSn預設值，兼顧成本效益。
lightingSystems.source: Technical.pdf Appendix 2 Table 10 照明能源管理優惠係數 βi

lightingSystems.name: 模式/時程設定且可調光
lightingSystems.hint: Scheduled mode control with continuous dimming capability. β=0.80. Good performance credit.
lightingSystems.hintZh: 模式/時程設定加調光功能，β=0.80，節能優惠係數良好。
lightingSystems.source: Technical.pdf Appendix 2 Table 10 照明能源管理優惠係數 βi

lightingSystems.name: BEMS整合遠端控制
lightingSystems.hint: Full BEMS integration with remote monitoring and control. β=0.75. Best available lighting credit under BERSn.
lightingSystems.hintZh: BEMS整合遠端監控，β=0.75，BERSn照明最高節能優惠係數。
lightingSystems.source: Technical.pdf Appendix 2 Table 10 照明能源管理優惠係數 βi

elevatorTypes.name: 一般交流變壓 ACVV 電梯
elevatorTypes.hint: Standard ACVV elevator. Et=1.0 (baseline, no efficiency credit). Manual input required: number of elevators and YOHj annual operating hours.
elevatorTypes.hintZh: 標準ACVV電梯，Et=1.0（基準值，無節能優惠）。需手動輸入台數及年運轉時數YOHj。

elevatorTypes.name: 變壓變頻螺旋齒輪 VVVF 電梯
elevatorTypes.hint: VVVF with helical gear. Et=0.6. 40% energy reduction vs ACVV. Common in mid-rise buildings.
elevatorTypes.hintZh: VVVF螺旋齒輪電梯，Et=0.6，較ACVV節能40%，常用於中高層建築。

elevatorTypes.name: 變壓變頻永磁同步馬達 VVVF 電梯
elevatorTypes.hint: VVVF with permanent magnet synchronous motor. Et=0.5. 50% energy reduction vs ACVV. BERSn default — widely used modern type.
elevatorTypes.hintZh: VVVF永磁同步馬達電梯，Et=0.5，較ACVV節能50%，BERSn預設，現代建築主流型式。

elevatorTypes.name: 永磁同步馬達 VVVF + 電力回生電梯
elevatorTypes.hint: VVVF permanent magnet with regenerative energy recovery. Et=0.4. Best elevator efficiency. Braking energy fed back to grid.
elevatorTypes.hintZh: VVVF永磁同步馬達加電力回生，Et=0.4，電梯類別中最高效能，制動能量回饋電網。

dhwSystems.name: 無中央熱水系統
dhwSystems.tableRef: Technical.pdf §3-3-2 — HpEUI=0 for non-central hot water
dhwSystems.hint: No central hot water system. HpEUI=0. Select this if only local water heaters (bathroom, kitchenette) are used.
dhwSystems.hintZh: 無中央熱水系統，HpEUI=0。若僅有局部熱水器（浴室、茶水間）請選擇此項。
dhwSystems.source: Technical.pdf §3-3-2 states non-central-hot-water cases set HpEUI=0

dhwSystems.name: 電熱儲熱系統
dhwSystems.hint: Electric resistance storage hot water. EHW=1.56. Manual input required: HPC (total installed heating capacity in kW).
dhwSystems.hintZh: 電熱儲熱式熱水系統，EHW=1.56。需手動輸入HPC（總加熱容量kW）。

dhwSystems.name: 燃油鍋爐儲熱系統
dhwSystems.nameEn: Fuel Oil Boiler Hot Water System
dhwSystems.hint: Fuel oil boiler hot water system. EHW=0.98. Manual input required: HPC (kW). Less common in new buildings.
dhwSystems.hintZh: 燃油鍋爐熱水系統，EHW=0.98。需手動輸入HPC(kW)。新建建築較少採用。

dhwSystems.name: 天然氣鍋爐儲熱系統
dhwSystems.nameEn: Natural Gas Boiler Hot Water System
dhwSystems.hint: Natural gas boiler hot water system. EHW=0.75. Manual input required: HPC (kW). Common in hotels and hospitals.
dhwSystems.hintZh: 天然氣鍋爐熱水系統，EHW=0.75。需手動輸入HPC(kW)，常用於旅館及醫院。

dhwSystems.name: 熱泵儲熱系統
dhwSystems.nameEn: Heat Pump Hot Water Storage System
dhwSystems.hint: Heat pump hot water system. EHW=0.5. Most efficient DHW option. Manual input required: HPC (kW, compressor capacity).
dhwSystems.hintZh: 熱泵熱水系統，EHW=0.5，DHW中最高效率。需手動輸入HPC（kW，壓縮機容量）。
